title: Slack Tide
schema_note: Neutral schema. Cline must map to the engine's game.json / intel schema. Ids are stable.

values.candor: Telling the truth, calling out lies. Falls when you bluff.
values.mercy: Sparing, aiding, leading rather than cutting down.
values.fairness: Honest dealing: fair prices, fair tips, no skimming.
values.nerve: Standing your ground when it costs you.
values.patience: Waiting out slack water instead of forcing a crossing.
values.fidelity: Keeping promises and keeping seals unbroken.
values.curiosity: Listening, asking, reading what you were not meant to read.
values.restraint: Declining the violent or powerful shortcut when another way exists.

value_events.trigger: Deliver a sealed parcel with the seal intact
Break a parcel seal to read it (flag seals_broken += 1)
Read a parcel with the Skeleton Seal (no seal broken)
Attempt a bluff on a check you fail on reliability
Correctly call out a lie (conflict check passes)
Accuse someone using a false or forged token
Return a lost purse or overpaid change
Join Doss's fare skimming
Wait out slack water instead of forcing a crossing
Force a crossing or skip a wait for gain
Stop to aid a cold or wounded passenger (costs a slot)
Lead a pleading silt-wight to the surface
Kill a pleading or surrendering creature
Stand your ground against the lullhound or a wight pack
Flee a fight you could have won safely
Keep an appointment or promise on time
Break a promise or miss an appointment
First full conversation with a new NPC
Sell a secret that harms a decent person
Use force when a non-violent route was open
Refuse a bribe or a look-away payment
Pay the Pale Collector's toll honestly
Pay a poor passenger's fare from your own pocket (-2t)

ferry_deck.name: The ferry Patience (deck)
ferry_deck.note: Every crossing scene. Passenger manifest is generated per leg.

sorrel_landing.name: Sorrel Landing
sorrel_landing.note: Home dock. Hesper's office, Ballast & Rope chandlery (Goldie).

low_lantern.name: The Low Lantern
low_lantern.note: Tavern. Cobb, Fen, Doss in the evenings. Gossip hub.

marl_landing.name: Marl Cross
marl_landing.note: Mid-river island town. Wharf, scrapyard, market. Salt Steps open at low ebb only.

tally_house.name: Tally & Prewitt Counting-House
tally_house.note: Ottoline's broker desk, Corvin's post, the ledger under the third stair.

customs_house.name: The Customs House
customs_house.note: Wimble's records desk, Vosk's rooms, cellar of old sluice ledgers.

far_wend_landing.name: Far Wend
far_wend_landing.note: East bank hill town. Yarrow's wagon, Captain Brack's lodge, Warden post.

croy_lighthouse.name: Croy's Lamp
croy_lighthouse.note: Lighthouse and lamp room. The only working signal lamp.

reedwick_marsh.name: Reedwick Marsh
reedwick_marsh.note: Heron-stone path, Toma's stilt hut, the kelpmother's pool. On foot at low tide.

cormorant_rocks.name: Cormorant Rocks
cormorant_rocks.note: Sister Wenna's bell-house. Boat only (skiff hire 4t).

salt_steps.name: The Salt Steps
salt_steps.note: Tidal stair. Dry only in the first hour of dawn/dusk ebb. Pale Collector, gulchers.

drowned_arcade.name: The Drowned Arcade
drowned_arcade.note: Flooded arcade of the old undercity. Wights at slack, gulchers, lullhound.

bellmakers_cistern.name: The Bellmaker's Cistern
bellmakers_cistern.note: Password knock leads under the Weir.

weir_gatehouse.name: The Weir Gatehouse
weir_gatehouse.note: Reached by boat via the Lesser Gate. Doon's post. Guards in seeds A and B.

weir_underworks.name: The Weir Underworks
weir_underworks.note: Machinery, seals, the Sunken Choir. Finale.

hesper.name: Hesper Quillon
hesper.role: Ferrymaster of the Patience. Your employer.

doss.name: Doss Pellam
doss.role: Fellow deckhand. Gossip, skimmer, rumor mill.

goldie.name: Marigold 'Goldie' Fenn
goldie.role: Chandler at Ballast & Rope. Sells gear.

cobb.name: Ma Cobb
cobb.role: Landlady of the Low Lantern. Hears everything.

fen.name: Fennick 'Fen' Aldous
fen.role: Old salvager. Tides, boats, the Stairs.

ottoline.name: Ottoline Prewitt
ottoline.role: Head clerk and info broker, Tally & Prewitt.

vosk.name: Dame Perrin Vosk
vosk.role: Retired customs inspector. Gift: Skeleton Seal.

doon.name: Ilsabet Doon
doon.role: Weirkeeper. Culprit A; ally or obstacle.

harrow.name: Warden-Courier Lisle Harrow
harrow.role: Dies on Day 2 leaving a sealed satchel.

gatehouse_guard.name: Gatehouse guard
gatehouse_guard.role: Doon's oath-guards (A) or Tally hirelings (B). None in C.

other_sources.satchel: Harrow's sealed satchel (open it, or hear it from Brack after delivery)

storm_lantern.name: Storm lantern
storm_lantern.effect: Light source. Required below the Salt Steps.

salt_pouch.name: Salt pouch
salt_pouch.effect: One line of salt stops a wight pack for a scene.

felt_overshoes.name: Felt overshoes
felt_overshoes.effect: Silent movement. Lullhound cannot hear you.

boarding_pike.name: Boarding pike
boarding_pike.effect: Weapon. Reach. Works on wights, gulchers, lullhound.

ginger_tonic.name: Ginger tonic
ginger_tonic.effect: Heals. Carry two for any hard road.

boat_hire.name: Seaworthy boat hire
boat_hire.effect: Passage to the Lesser Gate. Free if you are given the Patience.

bribe_customs.name: Customs cellar bribe
bribe_customs.effect: Access to the old sluice ledgers.

bribe_guard_b.name: Gatehouse guard bribe
bribe_guard_b.effect: Seed B only: Tally hirelings let you in.

warding_wick.name: Warding Wick
warding_wick.effect: Three charges. Banishes wights, sears the Choir.
warding_wick.line: I'm old. This has been in a drawer since the crew went under. Take it and put the dark out.

bell_of_turning.name: Bell of Turning
bell_of_turning.effect: One use. Rung at the third bell it turns the tide locally and settles the Choir.
bell_of_turning.line: It has waited longer than I have. Do not ring it early.

skeleton_seal.name: Skeleton Seal
skeleton_seal.effect: Read sealed parcels and open the gatehouse door without breaking anything.
skeleton_seal.line: Forty years and I never broke one. You have the same look. Take it.

eelskin_cloak.name: Eelskin Cloak
eelskin_cloak.effect: Armor. Cold and drowning resistance in the Stairs and the Underworks.
eelskin_cloak.line: You paid what the eels were worth. That is rarer than you think.

truthglass.name: Truthglass
truthglass.effect: Once per scene, shows whether an NPC's claim conflicts with a token in your journal.
truthglass.line: It only clears for the honest. I have watched liars fog it.

lull_cutter.name: Lull-Cutter
lull_cutter.effect: Weapon. Cuts wights, gulchers and the Choir. Never dulls.
lull_cutter.line: It drank the Lull once. It wants someone who will not enjoy using it.

ferry_patience.name: The Patience (loan)
ferry_patience.effect: Free boat passage to the Lesser Gate. Saves the 30t boat hire.
ferry_patience.line: You gave notice like a person. Take her. Bring her back.

silt_wight.name: Silt-wight
silt_wight.nonviolent: Lead pleading wights to the surface (mercy).

sunken_choir.name: The Sunken Choir
sunken_choir.active: all seeds (asleep in A and B until provoked)
sunken_choir.nonviolent: Bell of Turning, or read its name (seed C).

tokens.name: The Weirkeeper works the sluice
tokens.text: The Weirkeeper closes the night sluice with her own hands at the third bell.

tokens.name: Hirelings work the sluice
tokens.text: Men paid in Tally coin close the night sluice at the third bell.

tokens.name: Nobody works the sluice
tokens.text: No hand touches the night sluice. It closes on its own, humming.

tokens.name: Harrow was silenced
tokens.text: Warden-Courier Harrow was silenced at the Weir gatehouse by Doon's oath-guards for what she saw.

tokens.name: Harrow was chased
tokens.text: Tally House men chased Harrow off the Marl wharf for the sluice log and she went into the water.

tokens.name: Harrow was taken by the Stairs
tokens.text: The Stairs pulled Harrow under. The marks on her are gulcher, not man.

tokens.name: The satchel holds Doon's plea
tokens.text: The satchel holds Doon's own letter to the Wardens, begging for bell-founders before the Weir fails.

tokens.name: The satchel holds the log
tokens.text: The satchel holds a page of the night-sluice log naming a paid crew.

tokens.name: The satchel holds a hum chart
tokens.text: The satchel holds a chart of hum-marks along the causeway, drawn in Harrow's hand.

tokens.name: It begins at the gatehouse
tokens.text: The Long Slack begins at the Weir gatehouse, where the sluice is held shut.

tokens.name: It begins at the Marl sluice-house
tokens.text: The Long Slack begins at the Marl Cross sluice-house, where the crew works to a Tally chit.

tokens.name: It begins beneath the Steps
tokens.text: The Long Slack begins in the Underworks under the Salt Steps, where the water hums.

tokens.name: Only the Assize can free Doon
tokens.text: Only the Wardens' Assize can release Doon from her oath. Then she will open the gate.

tokens.name: Expose the ledger
tokens.text: Break the consortium's hold: expose the ledger and the sluice crew will walk.

tokens.name: Ring the Bell
tokens.text: Ring the Bell of Turning at the third bell of Full Slack and the Choir will sleep.

tokens.name: Doon's lantern log
tokens.text: A lantern log in Doon's hand: a trimmed wick and a mark at every third bell of the night.

tokens.name: A lantern log, too fresh
tokens.text: A lantern log said to be Doon's. The ink is still tacky.

tokens.name: Tally chit for the sluice crew
tokens.text: A Tally House chit dated the night before the first Long Slack, made out to 'sluice crew'.

tokens.name: A Tally chit, seal off
tokens.text: A Tally House chit made out to 'sluice crew'. The seal is a shade off.

tokens.name: The stone hums
tokens.text: Stand on the Salt Steps at slack and the stone hums up through your boots.

tokens.name: The Steps are dry at ebb
tokens.text: The Salt Steps are dry only in the first hour of dawn and dusk ebb.

tokens.name: Each slack runs longer
tokens.text: Each slack lasts longer than the last, by about a quarter hour every third day.

tokens.name: The third stair is rotten
tokens.text: The third landing of the Salt Steps is rotten. Bring rope.

tokens.name: Follow the heron-stones
tokens.text: Reedwick's safe path follows the heron-stones. Step off them and the marsh keeps your boots.

tokens.name: Drowned marks still spend
tokens.text: Drowned marks, the old coin, turn up along the Steps and still spend with the Pale Collector.

tokens.name: Three gates, one small
tokens.text: The Weir has three gates. Only the Lesser Gate opens to a small boat at slack.

tokens.name: The cistern goes under the Weir
tokens.text: Under the Salt Steps the Bellmaker's cistern runs beneath the Weir, if you know the knock.

tokens.name: Croy's lamp calls the ferry
tokens.text: Croy's lamp at Far Wend is the only working signal lamp and can call the ferry after dark.

tokens.name: The old ledgers are in the cellar
tokens.text: The old sluice ledgers are shelved in the Customs House cellar.

tokens.name: Full Slack stops the ferry
tokens.text: When slack lasts a full day the ferry will not run. Hesper calls it Full Slack.

tokens.name: Wights rise at slack
tokens.text: Silt-wights only rise at slack water.

tokens.name: Salt stops a wight
tokens.text: A line of salt stops a silt-wight. A warded wick banishes it.

tokens.name: Some wights remember
tokens.text: Some silt-wights are drowned laborers who still remember. They can be led up, not cut down.

tokens.name: Gulchers shy from iron
tokens.text: Gulchers shy from iron. Scatter nails on the steps.

tokens.name: The lullhound hunts by sound
tokens.text: The lullhound hunts by sound, not sight.

tokens.name: A clatter draws it off
tokens.text: A clatter thrown down a passage pulls the lullhound away from you.

tokens.name: The kelpmother takes eels
tokens.text: The kelpmother takes three fresh eels and asks nothing more.

tokens.name: Pay the Collector
tokens.text: The Pale Collector wants three drowned marks. He is not fought. He is paid.

tokens.name: The Choir fears flame
tokens.text: The Sunken Choir cannot abide open flame. A warded wick hurts it.

tokens.name: Hesper prizes a kept word
tokens.text: Hesper values a kept word above a full purse. She will lend the Patience to someone who leaves honestly.

tokens.name: Discount Doss by half
tokens.text: Doss embroiders. Halve whatever he tells you.

tokens.name: Ma Cobb hears the Reach
tokens.text: Ma Cobb hears the whole Reach for the price of a warm cup.

tokens.name: Fen is good before noon
tokens.text: Fen Aldous is reliable on tides before noon and worthless after gin.

tokens.name: Ottoline pays double for the unique
tokens.text: Ottoline pays double for what nobody else has.

tokens.name: Croy keeps a wick-staff
tokens.text: Ansel Croy keeps an old wick-staff in the lamp room. He says it should have been laid down with the crew. He gives to the merciful who hold their hand.

tokens.name: Wenna keeps a tide-bell
tokens.text: Sister Wenna keeps a bell that turned tides in her mother's day. She only speaks to people who can wait.

tokens.name: Vosk never broke a seal
tokens.text: Dame Vosk caught a forged ledger by the smell of the ink. She trusts only those who have never broken a seal.

tokens.name: Toma deals fair or not at all
tokens.text: Toma Reedhand pays and charges fair. Cheat him once and he will never speak to you again.

tokens.name: Yarrow's glass catches lies
tokens.text: Yarrow Thistle's glass is said to catch a lie. She parts with it only to someone who never told one.

tokens.name: Brack's blade drank the Lull
tokens.text: Captain Brack's blade drank the Lull once. She gives it to the brave who are not cruel.

tokens.name: Doon answers to her oath
tokens.text: Ilsabet Doon has kept the Weir since her husband died there. She answers to her oath before anyone.

tokens.name: Corvin's pouch bears the Tally seal
tokens.text: Corvin Ashe carries a pouch stamped with the Tally seal and has a nervous temper.

tokens.name: Hearsay sells at half
tokens.text: The counting-house buys hearsay at half price and corroborated facts at full.

tokens.name: A sold secret loses value
tokens.text: Once a secret is sold, it spreads. Each buyer pays less than the last.

tokens.name: Goldie rewards fair dealers
tokens.text: Goldie takes a tenth off for anyone who has never cheated a customer.

tokens.name: Brass sells at Marl
tokens.text: Salvaged brass fittings fetch four tallies each at the Marl scrapyard.

tokens.name: Smugglers tip to be ignored
tokens.text: Smugglers on the dusk run pay a few tallies to be ignored. Taking it costs you something else.

tokens.name: Fares double after the first week
tokens.text: Fares double after the first week, and tips with them.

tokens.name: The cellar costs eight
tokens.text: Wimble opens the cellar for eight tallies if nobody is looking.

tokens.name: Eels cost six a bundle
tokens.text: A bundle of three fresh eels is six tallies at Toma's hut or the Marl market.

tokens.name: Boat hire is thirty
tokens.text: Fen hires a seaworthy boat for thirty tallies. A skiff for the Rocks is four.

tokens.name: Doss skims the fares
tokens.text: Doss skims a tenth of the fares on the Marl run and Hesper does not know.

tokens.name: The Patience is mortgaged
tokens.text: The Patience is mortgaged to Tally & Prewitt, due at month's end.

tokens.name: The real ledger is under the stair
tokens.text: The counting-house's real ledger sits under the third stair.

tokens.name: Corvin's brother drowned
tokens.text: Corvin's brother drowned in the Stairs. He hates the Reach for it.

tokens.name: Doon's husband died at the Weir
tokens.text: Doon's husband drowned in the Weir's first flood. She has not left the gatehouse since.

tokens.name: Wimble sells the records
tokens.text: Clerk Wimble sells access to the records if paid and unobserved.

tokens.name: Smugglers use the Marl wharf
tokens.text: Smugglers use the Marl Cross wharf at dusk.

tokens.name: Turning Word: first
tokens.text: The first Turning Word is 'Ebb'. Fen sings it when drunk.

tokens.name: Turning Word: second
tokens.text: The second Turning Word is 'Hold'. It is in the nursery rhyme Ma Cobb hums.

tokens.name: Turning Word: third
tokens.text: The third Turning Word is 'Turn'. It is cut into the plaque at the Lesser Gate.

tokens.name: The turn is done at the third bell
tokens.text: The turning is done at the third bell, and only during Full Slack.

tokens.name: The gatehouse door knows a master seal
tokens.text: The gatehouse door answers to a Customs master seal.

tokens.name: Knock twice, pause, once
tokens.text: At the Bellmaker's cistern, knock twice, pause, then once.

tokens.name: Three witnesses convene the Assize
tokens.text: Three witnesses' worth of corroborated tokens will convene the Wardens' Assize at Far Wend.

common_turn.note: Every road ends with speaking the three Turning Words at the third bell of Full Slack.

A.result: The Assize compels Doon to release the gate.

B.result: The Assize convicts the consortium; the crew walks.

C.result: You read the Choir the name in Harrow's chart; it quiets.

A.result: You help Doon reseal the Underworks; she opens the gate willingly.

B.result: Ottoline stands the crew down in exchange for your silence and a fee.

C.result: You ring the Bell; the Choir settles.

A.result: You take the gatehouse by force. The tide turns; Doon does not forgive you.

B.result: You break the crew's hold at the sluice-house. Tally House remembers.

C.result: You silence the Choir with flame and steel. It stays silent, and so does the Weir.
